title: The Music
description: Eric asks Tappy what kind of music he remembers, and whether it came from somewhere in particular.
transcript: Tappy! Well, that’s a lot easier to say than “stranger with opinions.” Music, eh? That’s either the best clue we’ve had or the strangest. Was it the sort that makes the scrap feel like a dance floor, or the sort that means someone’s about to make a bad decision? And did it come from somewhere in particular?
